annotations.title: Buy appraisals for a portfolio: prepaid balance ($0.03/name)

description: RAIL: PREPAID BALANCE. Buy the existing current_appraisal service for up to 10 domains in ONE call, using a prepaid agent account and an operator's existing spending grant: $0.03 per name drawn from the prepaid balance, so one call charges at most $0.30. This is purchase_appraisal fanned out, not a new ledger: name i is an ordinary purchase-1 purchase under the derived operationId <operationId>:<i>, enforced by the original route (authentication, expiry, domain/product permissions, balance, grant limits, shared engine budget), and a name the engine cannot deliver is refunded to the account exactly as a single purchase is. Connect with Authorization: Bearer ad_agent_<token>; never put credentials in arguments. Supply an explicit operationId (at most 126 characters), grantId, domains (1 to 10 distinct names) and maxSpendUsd, the TOTAL ceiling for the call, which must cover $0.03 per name. Names run sequentially; a per-name refusal is recorded and the rest still run, while an uncertain outcome stops the call with the remaining names not_attempted. Retrying with the SAME operationId and the original arguments returns the stored per-name receipts and never charges a name twice; read them any time with portfolio_purchase_status. One purchase invocation per MCP request, and this tool counts as that invocation. This tool cannot fund the account, create grants or raise a limit. Not this rail when a person will pay at a checkout page, or when the operator enrolled a card instead of funding a balance: those rails stay single-name (buy_appraisal, buy_appraisal_agent_card). Configuration does not guarantee live readiness; the route's response is authoritative.

domains.description: The domains to appraise, 1 to 10 distinct names. Order matters: keep it identical on any retry, because per-name operationIds are positional.

maxSpendUsd.description: Explicit maximum TOTAL USD-equivalent service-credit spend for this whole call; must cover $0.03 per name ($0.30 for 10 names). No inferred or automatically increased ceiling.

operationId.description: Caller-chosen identifier for the whole portfolio purchase. Persist it before calling and reuse it with the original arguments after a lost reply; per-name purchases are derived from it, so never generate a new identifier for a retry.
